clips.title: The story
paras: A half of the Tome of the Cabal lies ruined on the Hillsbrad coast. Salvaged from a shipwreck, the Moldy Tome holds dark rituals sought by warlocks who study demonic summoning.

The Tome of the Cabal was a rare work of dark arts held in Lordaeron. At some point, it was vandalized and torn in two. One half, now called the Moldy Tome, traveled by ship south toward Menethil Harbor and Ironforge. The vessel never arrived. It sank in the dangerous waters west of Southshore, and the surviving half washed ashore south of Azurelode Mine. Damp and surf ruined its pages, while murlocs scavenged along the Hillsbrad coast.
